items.name: Ice
items.description: Ice is a type of Block used to craft various Habitats and structures in Pokemon Pokopia. Check out an overview of the item, how to get blocks of Ice, and how to use it here!
items.location_summary: Palette Town (Natural) | Eevee Doll Dream Island (Natural) | Clefairy Doll Dream Island (Natural) | Freezing Chambers kit (Build Kit)
items.obtain_method: Head Inside the Waterfall Where You Get the Freezing Chambers Kit | Ice Can Also Be Obtained at a Dream Island Containing Suicune: If you manage to find Suicune in one of the Dream Islands , make sure to ransack the room it was in . It is filled with amazing Blocks like Cube Lights and, most importanly, Ice!: You can get to Suicune by asking Drifloon to take you there with a Doll ! It is currently unknown which specific ones which lets you encounter it, but we found luck with using a Poke Doll...
items.crafting_recipe: Required for Certain Kits: Certain Kits, like the Freezing Chambers Kit , needs Ice in order to be created. Keep in mind that Kits require time to be built , so try to make it at the end of the day when you have nothing else to do! | Can be Used for Crafting Houses and Structures: If you have extras, you can use Ice to create Houses for other Pokemon to live in! You can also just use it to decorate an area to make them happier about their living habitat .

items.location_summary: In glowing terrain
items.obtain_method: Look for Glowing Spots in the Ground: Breaking Glowing Spot are the only way you can obtain Mysterious Slates . If the Glowing Spot is in front of you, you must use Rock Smash in order to destroy and break the block open.: Ancient Artifacts such as Lost Relics, CDs, Fossils, and other rare Materials can also be acquired by breaking Glowing Spots, so be prepared for a lot of tradeable and giftable items. | Dowsing Machine With a Search Pokemon: The Dowsing Machine is used to search for more Glow...
items.crafting_recipe: Attach Mysterious Slates to Unown Letters: You can attach Mysterious Slates that you find around the area to the Mysterious Mural. You will need to match them according to the corresponding Unown Alphabet found on the back of the slate.: Attaching all 27 Slates to the correct symbols will unlock the Pokemon, Mew, as a townsfolk.: The Mysterious Mural can be found northeast of the Pokemon Center in the Withered Wasteland . You will need to break the wall there to find the hidden area.: Afterward...
